capabilities: Browse folders in a distraction-free view
Generate and update index files for folders automatically
Display files in a card-based grid layout
Pin frequently used files and folders
Rename, delete and pin via hover buttons and navigate with breadcrumbs
disambiguation: Not a writing-focus or minimal-theme plugin; it is a replacement view for browsing and navigating vault files and folders.
extras: Distributed via BRAT (beta) or manual installation into the plugins folder; no community marketplace install is described. The 'Support the development' section is empty.
problem: The default file explorer shows every file in the vault, which is distracting when you only need the files relevant to what you are working on.
summary: Enhanced file explorer that shows only relevant files, with auto-generated index files, a card grid layout, pinned items and hover quick actions.
